title: Tank Internals, Heating & Agitation Systems
description: Thin-wall tubular heater sheaths and steam coils, perforated sparger pipes, venturi eductor nozzles, thermowell sleeves, float switch balls, weir overflow plates
designPrinciples: Material: Grade 2 (CP-Ti) thin-wall seamless tube for heater sheaths and steam coils provides excellent heat transfer with total corrosion immunity. Grade 5 for eductor nozzles requiring high erosion resistance
Form: Seamless thin-wall tube for heater sheaths and steam coils. Tube drilling for sparger pipes. CNC machining for nozzle orifices. Sheet metal forming for weir overflows.
engineeringTrends: Process: Tube bending of steam coils (mandrel bending to prevent collapse)
Process: Laser/perforation drilling of sparger pipes
Process: CNC machining of venturi nozzle profiles
comparisonNotes: Standards: ASTM B338 Grade 2 seamless tube (heater/coil) / ASTM B348 Grade 5 (nozzles), 100% pressure tested
relatedCapabilities: Tube bending of steam coils (mandrel bending to prevent collapse)
CNC machining of venturi nozzle profiles
